name: Yandex Cloud Kaluga Data Center
notes: Yandex announced a 63 MW, 3,800-rack facility in Grabtsevo Industrial Park, Kaluga, scheduled for 2023; DataCenterMap now lists Yandex Cloud Kaluga at 1-y Avtomobil'nyy Proyezd, 8. Status inferred operational from current facility listing.

name: Mining Cluster Republic of Komi gas-powered data center campus
notes: Mining Cluster pages list a Republic of Komi gas energy-center data center site with 220 MW total capacity, 112 MW under construction and 108 MW in design, described as a strategic project with Gazprom-backed energy supply. Mining-focused facility.

name: North Karelia distributed data center network / KY Data Center Nadvoitsy
developer: Petrozavodsk State University; GS Nanotech; KY Data Center
notes: 2019-2020 reports said PetrSU and GS Nanotech planned a 10 billion ruble distributed data-center network in Karelia, including a central node in Petrozavodsk and northern facilities; TASS reported investor KY Data Center had already invested 520 million rubles at the Rusal aluminum plant site in Nadvoitsy. No recent completion evidence found, so status is unknown.

name: DataHarbour Kursk
notes: Official DataHarbour page lists its Kursk data center sales office/facility at Prospekt Leninskogo Komsomola, 2, describes a Tier-3 platform with 24/7 support, colocation, rack rental, dedicated and virtual servers; DataCenterMap and ColoMap corroborate the Kursk facility.

name: RTCloud / 24DC Krasnoyarsky Data Center
notes: RTCloud official page lists TsOD Krasnoyarsky at Akademika Kirenskogo 87b with Tier-III, 40 cabinets, 200 square meters, 200 kW and 7 kW per cabinet; DataCenterMap lists 24DC at the same address operated by System Projects LLC.

name: OPTIBIT Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists OPTIBIT Data Center at Akademika Kirenskogo St, 89, Krasnoyarsk, operated by Optibit LLC and carrier-neutral. No primary operator page or power figure found.

name: Selectel Dubrovka 1
notes: Selectel official data-center page lists Dubrovka 1 in Nevskaya Dubrovka, Leningrad Oblast, with 740 sqm server-room area, 424 racks and 2.5 MW connected power; Selectel says its facilities meet Tier III standards.

name: Selectel Dubrovka 2
notes: Selectel official page lists Dubrovka 2 at Nevskaya Dubrovka, ul. Sovetskaya 1, with 931 sqm server-room area, 291 racks and 2.5 MW connected power.

name: Selectel Dubrovka 3
notes: Selectel official page lists Dubrovka 3 at the same Nevskaya Dubrovka address, with 768 sqm server-room area, 281 racks and 2 MW connected power.

name: PhosAgro Volkhov Data Center
notes: Rostelecom official release says it began building a new data center for PhosAgro at Apatit's Volkhov branch in Leningrad Oblast, with redundant high-speed links, three independent power sources, batteries and diesel generation; completion expected in 2026. No MW disclosed.

name: RUTUBE Leningrad Oblast data center
notes: Russian business/telecom press reported RUTUBE plans its first owned data center in Leningrad Oblast to expand AI capacity; construction is expected to start in late 2026 with commissioning planned for 2028. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Media Land / ProProject immersion-cooled data center
notes: Invest in Russia regional portal lists a Leningrad Oblast project for an immersion-cooled data center, published and last updated 2021-07-01, with a 400 million ruble project budget and 300 million ruble external financing need. No recent execution evidence found.

name: Smart TsOD Lipetsk modular data center
notes: LipetskNews reported the modular data center in the Lipetsk SEZ began operating in April 2024 for Smart TsOD Lipetsk; GreenMDC says the ScalableMDC TelecomOutdoor NG facility was built outdoors with technology modules, corridor and administrative blocks. Capacity not disclosed.

name: AFK Sistema / Sistema-Krypto Magadan Oblast Data Center
developer: AFK Sistema / Sistema-Krypto; Government of Magadan Oblast; RusHydro/Magadanenergo power partners
notes: Kolyma-Inform, citing the Magadan Oblast government, says the data center has a 150 MW grid connection contract with Magadanenergo, design is complete, expert approval received, the site was prepared and major structures were being procured. Interfax earlier reported AFK Sistema planned a 150 MW Magadan data center with RusHydro power supply.
